@@U03439@@
If to become is your wish, do it on your own!

@@U03441@@
Good advice isn’t to be scorned.

@@U03443@@
Off you go, then! We'll see what happens.

@@U03444@@
(They separate.)

@@U03446@@
(To 泰勒斯.)

@@U03447@@
Will that stubborn mind of yours never bend? What more will it take to convince you?

@@U03449@@
The wave bends willingly to every breeze, but stays away from rugged rocks like these.

@@U03451@@
That cliff was made by fiery vapors.

@@U03453@@
No, it’s in water that life came to be.

@@U03455@@
(Between them.)

@@U03456@@
Please let me stay beside you. I, too, want to come to be.

@@U03458@@
Tell me, 泰勒斯, have you ever in a single night managed to make a mountain out of mud?

@@U03460@@
Nature, and Nature’s living flow, has never been enslaved to hours and days. Every form she fashions according to rules; and no matter how huge the scale, there’s no place for violence.
translation:
@@U03439@@
如果成为是你的愿望，那就自己实现吧！

@@U03441@@
好的建议不应该被忽视。

@@U03443@@
那你就走吧！我们会看看会发生什么。

@@U03444@@
（他们分开了。）

@@U03446@@
（致泰勒斯。）

@@U03447@@
你那颗顽固的心永远不会弯曲吗？还需要什么才能说服你呢？

@@U03449@@
海浪会随微风而弯曲，但会远离这些崎岖的岩石。

@@U03451@@
那悬崖是由炽热的蒸气形成的。

@@U03453@@
不，生命是在水中诞生的。

@@U03455@@
（他们之间。）

@@U03456@@
请让我留在你身边。我也想成为这样的人。

@@U03458@@
告诉我，泰勒斯，你曾经在一夜之间用泥巴造出了一座山吗？

@@U03460@@
自然，以及自然的生命之流，从来没有被时间和日子所奴役。她按照规则塑造每一种形式；无论规模有多大，都没有暴力的余地。
